title: USDA FoodData Central
agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
questions: calories and protein in a food
nutrients of foods as eaten in NHANES (FNDDS)

key_only: more than a few requests an hour (DEMO_KEY limits; a free key allows 1,000 an hour)

manual.how: Open the links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (they carry DEMO_KEY, which works in a browser for a few requests; replace it with your own api.data.gov key if refused), save each under the shown name and upload. For whole data types download CSV or JSON from https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/download-datasets, or search https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-search and download a food's data.

cache.why: Requests are small; FDC publishes new releases of each data type periodically (publishedDate per food). data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: FoodData Central data are in the public domain under CC0 1.0 (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-guide, Licensing); USDA asks that FoodData Central be listed as the source.

citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central: {dataset}. fdc.nal.usda.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which data type: Foundation (generic foods, analytical values), SR Legacy (generic foods, final 2018 release), Survey (FNDDS, foods as eaten), or Branded (label values of specific products)?
Per 100 g (how FDC reports nutrients) or per serving? Per-serving values need the food's serving size or portion weight.
